Fix `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Undo is recorded on the wrong page (FR-21): test 'pages > keeps undo on its page' (packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx:337) moves r1 on the default page, switches to page 2, moves r2, switches back and presses undo: r1.x stays 1 (expected 0). Cause: in componentDidUpdate, the block `if (prevState.activePageId !== this.state.activePageId) { this.history.setActivePage(this.state.activePageId); ... }` (around line 4337) runs BEFORE `this.store.commit(elementsMap, this.state);` (around line 4533), so the pending element change from the page being left is committed and recorded (history.record via store.onDurableIncrementEmitter, line ~3866) into the NEW page's undo stack. Fix: call `this.history.setActivePage(this.state.activePageId)` only AFTER `this.store.commit(elementsMap, this.state)` in componentDidUpdate (keep the fonts reload where it is, or move it with it). Change nothing else.
